requirements.description: User explicitly prefers properties near parks. 'Near' implies proximity, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user prefers an energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes D, C, B and the A classes (A1-A4). Surface area (at least 115 sqm), capacity (15 people), proximity to parks, and the commercial-unit type are not in the available columns and are not filtered here.

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 115. The capacity of 15 people is not converted into an area threshold, since no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Energy class and proximity to parks are outside the reference columns and are handled elsewhere.
